description: GROUND TRUTH: listAllInvoices is unscoped and SHOULD fire TG-G4. The tenantId token belongs to auditFor, a separate statement, but falls inside the 5-line window of data-access.ts, so the detector currently misreads the unscoped query as tenant_scoped. This is a FALSE NEGATIVE in the flagship tenant-isolation gate. Expected encodes truth, not current behavior. Expected to FAIL until the window is statement-bounded.
